'''Many Shades of the Force''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that allowed a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] to utilize a force ability unique to the light or dark side like [[Force Light]] and apply it through viewing the Force as many shades of a rainbow, rather than a division of good and evil.<ref name="JATM" /> This form of force ability was used by the [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Omen" />

==Behind the scenes==
Many Shades of the Force was first introduced in the ''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]'', a [[1999]] supplement for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="JATM" />
